description: Thermische Energie Afvalwater (TEA - potentie) Effluent-leidingen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De laag TEA- potentie toont het potentieel aan restwarmte van Effluent-leidingen van RWZI's in Nederland. Waterschappen en enkele gemeenten leverden de data aan voor het berekenen van de TEA-potentie. Zie ook de voor meer informatie. Hoeveel warmte we uit het effluentwater kunnen halen, hangt af van de temperatuur van het water. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are effluent, tea-potentie, thermische-energie-afvalwater. It offers 1 resource(s) in PNG. The portal shows 2025-04-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
